552d7cabcbd51b26bd16.en: In the Newtalk News 2026 local elections, "blue and white" is still seen as a key variable that some counties may win or lose. Party leaders can talk about cooperation, candidates can coordinate, and even stand on the stage together. But will the supporters' tickets really be fully transferred to the collaborators after the "people to people"? Senior election trader Lin Yizheng, who served as the director of the DPP organization department and deputy secretary-general of the party, manipulated the DPP for many large elections, and was also responsible for the organization of Ke Wenzhe's first election as the mayor of Taipei in 2014. When Tsai Ing-wen ran for re-election in 2020, he put forward an estimate of 8.15 million votes. In the end, Tsai Ing-wen won more than 8.17 million votes, just over 20,000 votes away from his estimate, which also impressed the outside world. Lin Yizheng analyzed that in 2026, we will talk about the combination of blue and white. The first question is not "whether the two parties want to unite", but how much is left in the hands of blue and white respectively.
